北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -9℃。多穿衣物，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and cold, feels like -9℃. Dress warmly to avoid a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感微凉。注意保暖，别感冒啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and chilly. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 -1℃。出门记得加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and cool, feels like -1℃. Remember to wear a jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 2℃。有点凉，别忘添衣。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and cool, feels like 2℃. It's a bit chilly, remember to layer up.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 6℃。风大有点凉，注意保暖。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 6℃. Windy and chilly, stay warm.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 -2℃。早晚温差大，注意添衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like -2℃. Big temp difference, remember to add clothes.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴冷，体感 -4℃。注意防寒保暖，别冻着！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and cold, feels like -4℃. Stay warm and don't freeze!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 3℃。微凉，多喝热水暖暖身。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 3℃. A bit cool, drink hot water to warm up.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 -5℃。能见度低，出行慢行，注意保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like -5℃. Low visibility, drive slow, stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 -2℃。早晚温差大，注意保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like -2℃. Big temp difference, stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 4℃。风大湿冷，出行注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 4℃. Windy and damp cold, travel safely.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感 -25℃。出门请全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and extremely cold, feels like -25℃. Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -24℃。天寒地冻，多穿衣物哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and freezing, feels like -24℃. Bundle up and stay warm!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴好，体感 8℃。温差大，早晚添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 8℃. Big temp difference, add layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 4℃。风大湿冷，多穿点衣服。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 4℃. Windy and damp cold, wear more clothes.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 -5℃。风大体感低，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like -5℃. Windy and feels colder, protect from wind and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -10℃。天冷，别冻着了，多喝热水。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -10℃. It's cold, don't freeze, drink hot water.
